instantiated_cells.justification: State agencies that file a statement under § 13.695, and named officials, are expressly not subject to the licensing and registration provisions, so executive branch agencies are not required to register as lobbyists.
An elective state official (which includes the governor) is not subject to the lobbying registration/licensing provisions when acting in an official capacity.
An 'agency' includes state boards/commissions/departments and, if it files under § 13.695, it is not subject to lobbyist licensing or principal registration requirements.

The subchapter does not apply to lobbying of an agency official by an agency official of a different agency or the same agency, so government agencies lobbying other agencies are exempt from registration.
A legislative employee (including members/officers of the legislature) is not subject to the lobbying registration/licensing provisions when acting in an official capacity.
Individuals paid to lobby (including those employed by a lobbying firm) must be licensed and authorized before lobbying, so lobbying firms’ lobbyist-employees must register/license as lobbyists.
Every 'principal' exceeding $500 in lobbying expenditures must file a registration statement, and nothing in the definition of 'principal' excludes local governmental units that employ a lobbyist.
Except as authorized under § 13.621, a person may not lobby as a lobbyist unless licensed under § 13.63 and authorized under § 13.65.
A 'principal' is any person who employs a lobbyist, and every principal exceeding $500 in lobbying expenditures must register with the commission.

Because § 13.64 requires every principal (any 'person' employing a lobbyist) meeting the expenditure threshold to register and the statute does not carve out other public entities, such entities must register if they employ lobbyists and exceed $500.

A lobbyist must receive economic consideration other than reimbursement for actual expenses, so unpaid volunteer lobbyists are not 'lobbyists' and thus are not required to register/license as lobbyists.
